results.title: Ten concurrent reads of a `max_reads: 1` share
results.evidence: the cap held: 1 read served, 9 refused ['share_exhausted']. Read what held it — `open_share` is still a read-modify-write with no lock and no conditional update, and what serialised these ten was the database's own write lock under one process. ADR-016 chooses that topology, so the cap is safe where MAYA is deployed as specified and rests on the deployment rather than on this code
